form.title: Proposal Title
form.title_ph: e.g. Smart Library Management System with NFC
form.title_hint: A clear, descriptive title for your graduation project (5-20 words).
form.domain_hint: Proposals are automatically assigned to your specialization.
form.problem_ph: Clearly explain the real-world issue your system solves. Include context about who is affected and why existing solutions are insufficient.
form.problem_hint: Describe the specific problem domain and target audience (minimum 30 words).
form.solution_ph: Explain how your project solves the problem. Detail the core modules, methodology, and how users will interact with the system.
form.solution_hint: Outline the architecture and functionality of the proposed system (minimum 30 words).
form.objectives_ph:
1. Automate inventory tracking…
2. Predict book demands using AI…
form.objectives_hint: List the primary goals and key targets of the project (minimum 20 words).
form.functions_ph: Key features including: user dashboard, real-time alerts, payment gateway, neural network module.
form.functions_hint: List the key technical modules and user capabilities (minimum 20 words).
